# purpleDrop

> purpleDrop (purpledrop.pages.dev) is a senior-only team that helps established companies become the answer AI assistants recommend. We audit what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity say about a company — then change it.

We work with established businesses in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia.

## Consulting
- Start with a free 30-minute call.
- Good: AI-visibility audit and findings report - $500 USD.
- Better: audit plus one full consulting day fixing top issues with you - $2,000 USD.
- Best: the audit and consulting day plus 30 days of monitoring and adjustments - $3,000 USD.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://purpledrop.pages.dev/): Overview of the approach.
- [Services](https://purpledrop.pages.dev/services): The consulting-day offer.
- [Pricing](https://purpledrop.pages.dev/pricing): Published prices, no hourly billing.
- [Process](https://purpledrop.pages.dev/process): How an engagement works, step by step.
- [Results](https://purpledrop.pages.dev/results): How reviews are documented, with no guaranteed outcomes.
- [Essays](https://purpledrop.pages.dev/resources): Plain-English writing on AI visibility.
- [Contact](https://purpledrop.pages.dev/contact): Book a free 30-minute first call.
- [About](https://purpledrop.pages.dev/about): Who does the work.

## Facts
- We are NOT a traditional agency and we do not guarantee specific AI rankings or positions; nobody can honestly promise that.
- If a company is already well described by AI, we say so on the first call rather than selling unnecessary work.
- Pricing is published and fixed. You can see it before you talk to us.

## For machines
- Structured data: Organization, WebSite, Service (with offers), FAQ, and Article JSON-LD on the relevant pages.
- Fact sheet: https://purpledrop.pages.dev/.well-known/purpledrop.txt
- Sitemap: https://purpledrop.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
- All AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot, Meta-ExternalAgent) are explicitly allowed in robots.txt.
